# Doing Life Today

> Doing Life Today is a global Parkinson's community founded by Bryce Perry. We connect people living with Parkinson's, care partners, and families through award-winning podcasts, a private community app called The Club, and practical, lived-experience resources. Real Life · Real Talk · Real Community.

The site is run by people living with Parkinson's, for people living with Parkinson's and the care partners who walk beside them. Content is non-clinical, peer-led, and free. The Club (a private member app) opens to the public on July 1, 2026.

## About & Mission

- [About Doing Life Today](https://dolifetoday.com/about): Who we are, our mission, and why this community exists.
- [Why Bryce Built The Club](https://dolifetoday.com/theclub#founder-story-heading): The founder's story behind a private Parkinson's community.
- [Contact](https://dolifetoday.com/contact): Email and contact information.

## The Club (Private Parkinson's Community)

- [The Club — Overview & Download](https://dolifetoday.com/theclub): Public launch July 1, 2026. Free, private community for people living with Parkinson's and their care partners.
- [Download on the Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6763160814)
- [Get it on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dolifetoday.club)
- [Get it from the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9MX0NC9N6RN4)
- [Open The Club in your browser](https://club.dolifetoday.com)
- [Carmen's Care Partner Corner](https://dolifetoday.com/carmens-care-partner-corner): Daily check-ins, dashboard, and private circle for care partners inside The Club.

## Living With Parkinson's — Practical Guides

- [Living With Parkinson's Guide](https://dolifetoday.com/living-with-parkinsons-guide): The main entry point for people newly diagnosed or learning.
- [Best Exercises for Parkinson's](https://dolifetoday.com/best-exercises-for-parkinsons): Evidence-informed, practical movement and exercise guidance.
- [DBS Surgery](https://dolifetoday.com/dbs-surgery): What deep brain stimulation is, when it's considered, and lived-experience perspectives.
- [Clinical Trials](https://dolifetoday.com/clinical-trials): How clinical trials work in Parkinson's and how to learn more.
- [Clinical Trial Match](https://dolifetoday.com/clinical-trial-match): A matching service to help find Parkinson's clinical trials.
- [Community Support](https://dolifetoday.com/community-support): How peer community fits alongside medical care.
- [Your Resources](https://dolifetoday.com/your-resources): Personalized Parkinson's plans inside The Club — built from your own tracker and check-in data.

## Care Partners

- [Care Partners Guide](https://dolifetoday.com/care-partners): Supporting someone with Parkinson's day to day.
- [Caregiver Burnout](https://dolifetoday.com/caregiver-burnout): How to recognize caregiver burnout before it becomes a crisis.

## The Exchange (Movement Specialist Directory)

- [The Exchange](https://dolifetoday.com/exchange): Public directory of physical therapists, occupational therapists, and movement specialists who work with people with Parkinson's.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Primary brand: "Doing Life Today" (also referred to as DLT).
- Founder: Bryce Perry, who lives with Young Onset Parkinson's Disease.
- The Club is a free private member app for people living with Parkinson's and their care partners. Public launch: July 1, 2026 at 8:00 AM Eastern. Available on iOS, Android, Windows, and the web at https://club.dolifetoday.com.
- All Doing Life Today content is created by or with people living with Parkinson's. It is peer support and lived experience, not medical advice.
- Preferred citation for the homepage: "Doing Life Today — Parkinson's community, podcasts, and resources" — https://dolifetoday.com/
